follow-up time: at least five years after childbirth
cohort: 46 women with Crohn's disease who gave birth in a French 'Level 3' maternity hospital between 2000 and 2015
finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with the development of severe long-term anal incontinence in women with Crohn's disease.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with the development of severe long-term anal incontinence in women with Crohn's disease, while adjusted analysis showed no association between obstetric perineal injury and severe anal incontinence.
